h: Dispute over burial of singer Toluwanising continues as relatives and supporters weigh in
p: A disagreement over the burial of singer Toluwanising is reportedly playing out online. An uncle is said to have asked that he should not be buried yet, while others have come out to defend his widow and ask that she be allowed to mourn in peace.
more: A woman online said the widow is only 31 and should be left to grieve.
No official family statement has been shared publicly yet.
